notes.title: DUST-UP Early Access
notes.content:
Hey there!

For those who liked the mr.President Prologue Episode ragdoll physics, I'm glad to announce to you the early access of a ragdoll physics fighting named [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1016690/]DUST-UP[/url]!
No more run-right-and-just-fire-outside-the-screen gameplay, I realized that fighting is the best genre for these physics animations, and I'm happy to show you what I've done very soon.

Thank you for your attention.

notes.content:

[/list]
[*]Bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Game running bug
notes.content:
If the game didn't run, but Steam says it's running, just end all "nw.exe" processes and try to run the game again. If it didn't launch again just repeat the actions above. Sorry for inconvenience.
